text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, making an allegation or inquiry based on sex discrimination unviable. While an all-male panel might point to broader issues with institutional diversity or insular networking, bringing up gender in this context will distract from your legitimate concerns and weaken your credibility. 

Instead, focus entirely on merit and procedural transparency. You possess a master's degree in educational leadership and five years of administrative experience as deputy principal, whereas the appointee has primarily teaching experience. Follow up politely on your request for the written explanation, focusing strictly on the qualification criteria, interview scoring, and candidate evaluation metrics.
